### Which jobs are failing?

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-cluster-lifecycle-kubeadm#kubeadm-kinder-external-ca-latest
https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-cluster-lifecycle-kubeadm#kubeadm-kinder-kubelet-1-34-on-latest

and others:
https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-cluster-lifecycle-kubeadm

### Which tests are failing?

cluster-info task

### Since when has it been failing?

06 march 2026

### Testgrid link

_No response_

### Reason for failure (if possible)

kinder calls etcdctl --version` and makes sure it's parseable. but a recent change in the image results in the version being just `etcd`

```
etcd-kinder-xony-control-plane-1 << registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.6.8-0, 
etcd-kinder-xony-control-plane-2 << registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.6.8-0, 
etcd-kinder-xony-control-plane-3 << registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.6.8-0, 
...
kinder-xony-control-plane-1:$ kubectl --request-timeout=2 --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf exec -n=kube-system etcd-kinder-xony-control-plane-1 -- etcd --version
time="10:50:47" level=debug msg="Running: docker exec kinder-xony-control-plane-1 kubectl --request-timeout=2 --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf exec -n=kube-system etcd-kinder-xony-control-plane-1 -- etcd --version"

kinder-xony-control-plane-1:$ Using etcdctl version: etcd

Error: failed to exec action cluster-info: cannot parse etcd version: could not parse "etcd" as version
 exit status 1
```

~the etcd binary should return it's version info properly.~

EDIT: root cause explained here:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/137532#issuecomment-4016281181


### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

### Relevant SIG(s)

/sig cluster-lifecycle etcd

cc @pacoxu @ahrtr

```
k exec -n kube-system etcd-lubo-pc -- etcd --version
etcd Version: 3.6.7

```

maybe it's some containerd or kubectl change with `exec`.

EDIT: not containerd as we are pinning the version from the kind base images.

it's because of the new line: `Defaulted container "etcd" out of: etcd...`
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137399

```
./kubectl exec -n kube-system etcd-lubo-pc -- etcd --version
Defaulted container "etcd" out of: etcd
etcd Version: 3.6.7
Git SHA: e838ef1
Go Version: go1.24.11
Go OS/Arch: linux/amd64
```

we can update kinder to less naively parse the output, but @soltysh isn't that going to break other users too?

/sig cli
I guess these failures are the same. #137541 #137542

> I guess these failures are the same. [#137541](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/137541) [#137542](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/137542)

yes

Is the new output stderr or stdout?

Depending on stderr output is generally considered to be unwise and out of scope, since it is reserved for human facing log messages / warnings / ...

Stdout changes would be a breaking change IMHO. Stdout should be machine parseable output.

that's a good point. kinder seems to be combining stderr and stdout, which it probably shouldn't for a `--version` flag and only take one stream. although, historically the `--help` or `--version` flags of various tools could been printed on stderr or stdout.

i think the breakage here is that kubectl switched from having this on `V(4)` to printing it to a `warn` buffer which is presumably an stderr buffer:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137399/changes#diff-bb643003d7e8335c1645fb2db8cdc6e403dd514cfc948a5ecee36f34c760cb68L88

in the context of the message itself, i really think `Defaulted container "etcd" out of: etcd` should be a `V(1)` or more verbosity message. i.e. "yes, there is one default container out of 1 containers, but the average user doesn't care?"

EDIT: i pinged @soltysh on slack about this:
https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/CN0K3TE2C/p1773084776666529?thread_ts=1772882532.384339&cid=CN0K3TE2C
and yes, we can easily change kinder but wondering if we should hide this message with higher verbosity.

> in the context of the message itself, i really think Defaulted container "etcd" out of: etcd should be a V(1) or more verbosity message. i.e. "yes, there is one default container out of 1 containers, but the average user doesn't care?"


I proposed https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137591 to fix it.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a142b22c38efe76423f3123ea2f46dbca943fdc3/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/util/podcmd/podcmd.go#L81-L84

- `warn` log for ony-1-container pod may be not needed. 
- v(4) log will show the default container name for 1-container pod.
